_comment_baseUrl: baseUrl is NOT read from here — it MUST be set via the BASE_URL environment
variable in your .env file. See playwright.config.ts for details.
_comment_execution: Execution visibility — controls whether the browser shows on screen:
"headless": false  →  Visible (Headed) mode — watch tests run in real time
"headless": true   →  Background (Headless) mode — runs silently, no UI
_comment_staff: Staff names for patient Select2 interactions. Also available in config/patient-scenarios/*.scenario.json (_config.staff) for per-scenario overrides.

_comment_targetPatientIdentifier: targetPatientIdentifier — the Patient ID searched on the Patients list page
before creating/viewing appointments. This is the SINGLE source of truth used
by every appointment test — do NOT duplicate it in scenario files.
_comment_visitType: visitType — the appointment/visit type used by EVERY appointment test.
This is the SINGLE source of truth (like targetPatientIdentifier) — do NOT
duplicate it in scenario files. Must be 'Treatment Nurse Visit' for the

_comment_visitId: visitId — the target visit ID located in the Visits directory (list page /visits)
whose visit-form tabs (Flow Sheet, Patient Assessment, Discontinue Of Hemodialysis,
Vascular Access Assessment, Respiratory Triage, Referrals) are filled out by the
the row in the Visits list and opens the corresponding form/tab for this visit.
This is the SINGLE source of truth shared by ALL visit-form tests and scripts —
do NOT duplicate the visit ID in scenario files.
The visit must be of type 'Treatment Nurse Visit' for the forms to apply.
_comment_appointmentConfig: Appointment test parameters (defaultDurationMinutes, etc.) live in the _config block of each file in config/appointment-scenarios/, and form fields (date, time, notes, etc.) in _fields. targetPatientIdentifier, visitType and visitId are the exceptions — they are defined above so all tests share one consistent value.
